fit_membership.selection: uniform without replacement over sorted fit-train components, then one eligible train row group uniformly per selected component
fit_membership.sequence_policy: complete row-group sequence; all feature rows, no row subsampling or reordering

maps.name: side_swap
maps.permutation: for i0 and i1, exchange each p block [0:11] with [11:22] and each v block [0:11] with [11:22]

maps.name: price_axis_reflection
maps.permutation: same-index side_swap for p and v blocks of i0 and i1
maps.sign: -1 for every p and dp coordinate of i0 and i1; +1 otherwise
maps.target_transform: conditionally swap t0,t1 only if labels equal F-ask and bid-F

maps.name: price_sign_only_negative_control
maps.sign: -1 for every p and dp coordinate of i0 and i1; +1 otherwise

analysis.strong_marginal_mismatch: At least 16 of 32 components have more than 56 of 112 features whose maximum normalized quantile displacement exceeds 1.0.
analysis.interpretation: necessary marginal screen only; no target/equivariance/model claim and no augmentation authorization
